tests.note: npm test runs 7 files: combat, state, player, RustGrunt, WaveSpawner, arena.sim, optionsData. src/shared/combatData.test.mjs exists but is NOT in the npm test script. No tests cover Phaser scenes (ArenaScene, HudScene, ResultScene, Menu/Title/Options UI) or Zed.js.

features.summary: Zed movement: run, jump with coyote time and jump buffer, variable-height jump cut, gravity. Arcade physics sprite, fixed 60Hz state-machine step.

Input mapping with edge detection. Keyboard: left A/Arrow, right D/Arrow, jump W/Up/Space, light J/Z, heavy K/X, block I/V, dodge L/C, parry T/M. Gamepad: A jump, X light, Y heavy, B/RB dodge, LB/LT/RT block, dpad/left stick move. No gamepad parry mapping.

Zed attack state machine (idle/run/jump/attack/hitstun/block/dodge/parry) with startup/active/recovery frames, buffered chain cancels. 3-hit light combo light1 -> light2 -> light3 (finisher), heavy1 can be chained from light1/light2, heavy and light3 do not chain.

emits: hit-request (Zed.js:69, every active frame, same attackId per swing)

features.summary: Defence: dodge (in-place sway, i-frames then recovery, cooldown), parry key (negates hits during window, cooldown), block (held; first 8 frames of a fresh block count as parry, then block: damage x0.25 min 1, knockback x0.25, no hitstun). Dodge and parry reported to combat via getState().guard. No stamina or hp refund on parry (comment notes hp refund needs combat support).

Hit resolver: listens to hit-request, mirrors hitbox by facing, AABB vs registered hurtboxes of opposing team, dedupes per (attackId,target), applies damage via health component, emits damage-applied, player-health-changed, entity-died. Locks after round-won/round-lost, resets on retry. Player gets 400ms invulnerability after a hit; enemies none.

Hit-stop: pure helper capping and merging hit-stop durations (never stacks, takes longest, max 150). ArenaScene freezes only attacker and target ids; round timer and other entities keep running. Player hurt, light/heavy by amount >= 12.
features.note: hitStop.js pure helpers are referenced from combat tests only if combat.test imports them; scene wiring has no test. 'finisher' and 'ko' keys are defined but ArenaScene only ever selects light, heavy, playerHurt.

features.summary: Screen shake and spark FX on hits: player hurt shakes (100ms, 0.0023), player hit of >=12 damage shakes (120ms, 0.003). Spark image scaled by heavy. Not gated by options screenShake setting.

Rust Grunt AI state machine: idle -> approach -> telegraph -> attack -> recover -> approach, plus hitstun and dead. Lane alignment before attack, circle when attacker slots (cap 2) are full, knockback decay. Single enemy type only.
features.note: gruntData.js duplicates attack numbers that also live in src/shared/combatData.js GRUNT_ATTACK_COMBAT (identical values, gruntData does not import it).

features.summary: EnemyManager: spawns grunts, registers them with combat, forwards hit-requests, applies hitstun/knockback on damage-applied, kills on entity-died, corpse lingers 600ms then entity-unregistered. Supports frozen id set (hit-stop).

WaveSpawner: 3 waves of 3, 4, 5 grunts with maxAlive 3/3/4, spawn interval 900/800/700 ms, start delay 800/1500/1500 ms, round-robin spawn points just inside locked view edges. Emits wave-started/wave-cleared/arena-cleared. Next wave starts automatically after clear (no pause for player).
features.note: State config.js WAVES duplicates waveData.WAVES counts but is not imported by waves.

features.summary: Arena bounds and camera lock: view 1280x720, world 1920x720, lane y 460-680, lock margin 40. While a wave is active camera is held at the wave's lockX and fighters are clamped to the locked screen; after clear camera follows the player (lerp 0.12) within world bounds.
features.note: ArenaScene keeps Zed on a fixed ground line (GROUND_Y = LANE.maxY - 40 = 640); only x is clamped, no depth movement for the player.

features.summary: ArenaFailsafe: clamps live enemies to bounds each frame; every 250ms repositions enemies off-screen >2500ms or stuck >4000ms; removes after 3 teleports (counts toward wave clear).
Round state: 120 s countdown, timer-tick each whole second, round-lost 'timeout' at 0, round-lost 'ko' when player dies, round-won 'cleared' on arena-cleared; retry resets (unlimited retries).

HudScene: player health bar (360x28, turns red under 30%), hp text, wave banner ('FIGHT!' on wave 1, 'WAVE n' otherwise), 'WAVE n / total', 'ENEMIES LEFT', MM:SS timer (red at <=10s), 'Esc: pause' hint that fades after 5s. Uses plain Phaser text and graphics, not the ui.* asset keys.

ResultScene: pause overlay (RESUME / RESTART LEVEL with confirm / MAIN MENU with confirm), and end-of-round win/lose screens with stats (waves cleared, enemies defeated, time remaining, health) and PLAY AGAIN/TRY AGAIN or MAIN MENU. Retry emits 'retry'. Keyboard and gamepad nav.
Pause: Esc/P, gamepad Start (button 9), and tab blur pause ArenaScene and launch ResultScene in pause mode. END_DELAY_MS 700 before result screen.
Title screen then main menu (FIGHT, CONTROLS, OPTIONS, QUIT strips). FIGHT emits 'start-game' and starts ArenaScene. Scene order: TitleScene, MenuScene, ArenaScene, HudScene, ResultScene.

Options panel with persistence (localStorage key rebellion.options.v1). 12 settings: master/music/sfx volume (80/70/80), mute on focus loss, fullscreen, screen shake (Off/Light/Full), hit flash, timer visibility, notice display, reduced motion, high contrast, text size. Stored in scene registry 'options'; MenuScene comment says nothing consumes it yet, and grep finds no registry.get('options') outside the menu. There is no audio code in src.
features.note: Data layer tested and working; the settings are not applied to gameplay (stub in effect).

features.summary: Zed visuals: pose-based procedural animation per state plus frame clips (run 8f/13fps, attack cross punch 6f/24fps, light3 high kick 7f, dodge 9f, parry 9f) and a static jump pose. Hurt and dead states are procedural (tint/tilt/alpha 0.35), no dedicated frame art. ArenaScene only preloads 'Idle' and 'Jumping' rotations. Zed's physics sprite is hidden (alpha 0).

Grunt art is a single placeholder SVG (rust-grunt-placeholder.svg) shown with tint (white on hitstun, red ramp on telegraph) and rotated 80deg on death; telegraph icon and red hitbox preview during wind-up. Animation keys listed in asset-keys.json (rust.grunt.walk etc.) are not loaded or played.
Sandbox mode: ?sandbox query launches an empty arena with no waves, timer or lose condition.

Zed damage handling: on damage-applied (not guarded) enters hitstun for hitstun ms, knockback velocity, red tint; death sets dead flag; retry respawns at start position and re-registers. No lives, no pickups, no special/ultimate move, no weapons, no second character in code.

contractNotes: Events emitted/listened match design/team/contracts.md: entity-registered, entity-unregistered, hit-request, damage-applied, entity-died, player-health-changed, wave-started, wave-cleared, arena-cleared, timer-tick, round-won, round-lost, retry are all defined in src/shared/events.js and used.

Extra untracked-in-contract event strings: 'start-game' (MenuScene.js:321), 'blur' (listened in ArenaScene.js:82). ResultScene emits retry with the literal string 'retry' (ResultScene.js:134) rather than EVENTS.RETRY.
Contract Open section: round limit 120s, unlimited retries, 3 waves of 3/4/5, player hp 100, grunt hp 30, invuln 400ms are all documented as placeholders and match code.
